summary: Assemble the finite-harmonic electromagnetic frequency matrix, with causal signed-kz mapping and exact perpendicular velocity moments.

identity.definition: M acts on grouped three-current auxiliaries followed by Ex,Ey,Ez,Bx,By,Bz and satisfies M V=omega V. NN=3[S(2N+1)J+1]+6. For kz<0 assemble reflected drift at abs(kz) then transform polar z currents/Ez and axial Bx/By. At kz=0 use velocity-integral residues C0 and Cp, preserving auxiliary dimensions. The uniform kx=kz=0 physical tensor requires the cyclotron n=+/-1 moments independently of the selected scan truncation; this is a separately checked analytic limit. The approximated dielectric is K=I-sum_s(omega_ps^2/omega^2)I+sum_s,b,n(omega_ps^2/omega^2)r_bs <[-2(n Omega_s/vtp_bs^2+kz(vz-vd_s)/vtz_s^2)/(omega-kz vz-n Omega_s)] Pi_n>, with n=-N..N and normalized Gaussian velocity measure. Pi_n has rows(a^2,i a b,a c),(-i a b,b^2,-i b c),(a c,i b c,c^2), where a=n Omega_s J_n(kx vperp/Omega_s)/kx,b=vperp J_nprime,c=vz J_n. Analytic axis limits replace singular expressions. Parallel velocity integration is represented by the declared J-pole Z approximation; the response qualification is in Im(omega)>0.
identity.model: Uniform magnetized, nonrelativistic charged Gaussian species with optional gyrotropic loss-cone mixture; B0 along signed z and k=(kx,0,kz).
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: Caller retains the explicit truncation, state provenance and normalization.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: NativeResult or its state mapping produced by the named predecessor. Scalar numeric fields are usually1x1 native arrays; row/column singleton dimensions are retained. Scientific numeric transport is float64/complex128; inactive fields are empty arrays, never fabricated zeros.
inputs.units: mixed; physical dimensions recorded by state fields
inputs.constraints: Must contain the complete compatible predecessor state; handcrafted inconsistent fields are outside the qualified composition.

inputs.name: kx
inputs.constraints: Finite real representable binary64; excludes complex k.

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: Signed parallel wave number with causal z-reflection for negative values.
inputs.constraints: Finite real representable binary64; negative values retain signed drift/gyro and correct polar/axial transformation.

outputs.name: M
outputs.description: EM frequency eigenmatrix; last six components are E then B.
outputs.units: entries map physical state to omega times state
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: k
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

preconditions: EM iem=1 state; real signed kx/kz including exact perpendicular and zero-k cold-tensor limit.
supported: EM iem=1 state; real signed kx/kz including exact perpendicular and zero-k cold-tensor limit.
excluded: Global nonlinear plasma evolution and a guarantee of unique physical mode identification.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; incomplete or inconsistent state may raise KeyError or a native indexing/domain error. No silent physical-model substitution.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError records unavailable/failed/timed-out Octave execution. source_output additionally raises SourceOutputError with retained result and receipt when its caught scientific terminal fails.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Eigen/interpolation/selection native failure is observable; no failed root is converted to a successful mode. This operator does not certify global root convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Completed NativeResult carries immutable state and receipt. source_output failures expose partial artifacts through exception.result; other failed native calls do not promise a completed scientific state.

example.description: Small wheel-only example using packaged native resources and raw Octave; no source checkout or network.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk import magnetized as m, workflows as w
deck=np.array([[1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0],[-1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0.]])
controls=dict(B0=1e-7,N=1,J=4,sp=0,iem=1,iout=2,ipa=3,ipb=3,iloga=0,ilogb=0,pa1=.2,pa2=.4,dpa=.1)
eq=m.initialize_equilibrium(deck,controls=controls,par=[.2,0,.2,0,0,0])
r=m.electromagnetic_matrix(eq,kx=0.,kz=.2/float(eq.state['cwp'].item()))
assert r.state['M'].shape[0]==int(eq.state['NN'].item())
example.expected: Assertions succeed for a compatible installation with Octave. This demonstrates the declared operation, not global scientific or visual acceptance.

scope: Independent Eq11/12/13/16 direct velocity-integral EM response at separately resolved quadrature64/96 and harmonics8/12; K and K-I error<=5e-5 for the qualified J12N12 tuples.
Signed kz, signed B, anisotropy/drift/loss-cone and exact perpendicular/zero-k analytical response are checked; no all-mode convergence inferred.
